description: This file contains unit tests for the GatewaySettingsStore component, verifying persistence behaviors such as bootstrap copying between defaults and keychain, manual and discovered gateway connection storage, and API key management. It uses Swift testing framework annotations and interacts with external components like KeychainStore and UserDefaults.

classes.name: GatewaySettingsStoreTests
classes.description: Test suite for GatewaySettingsStore, including multiple test cases for persistence and migration behaviors.

methods.name: bootstrapCopiesDefaultsToKeychainWhenMissing
methods.description: Tests that the bootstrap method correctly copies default UserDefaults values to the keychain when the keychain entries are missing.

methods.name: bootstrapCopiesKeychainToDefaultsWhenMissing
methods.description: Tests that the bootstrap method correctly copies keychain values to UserDefaults when they are missing.

methods.name: lastGateway_manualRoundTrip
methods.description: Verifies saving and loading a last gateway manual connection configuration round-trip.

methods.name: lastGateway_discoveredOverwritesManual
methods.description: Tests that saving a discovered gateway connection overwrites a manual configuration.

methods.name: lastGateway_migratesFromUserDefaults
methods.description: Tests migration of legacy UserDefaults values to new keychain storage and verifies cleanup of legacy keys.

methods.name: talkProviderApiKey_genericRoundTrip
methods.description: Tests saving and loading of API keys for talk providers, ensuring proper keychain interaction and null handling.
